game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields, fields of drifting embers: the ember mage must handle molten golems while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split sulfur crystals evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ember Fields: fields of drifting embers
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read value for station 9, then display the same value without changing it. Test dataset 9: {'value': -9}; {'value': 27}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ember Fields'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the lava bridge using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The lava bridge reached with actions_used <= 15.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the lava bridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Divide Or Floor – Ember Fields Trial
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
